source: CBC News — Halloween candy multipacks shrinkflation

source: CBC News — Halloween candy multipacks shrinkflation
evidence: A 2024 ad for a Hershey's bag of 50 Halloween candy bars showed that the box weighed 513 grams. This year, the same product weighs 481 grams, a 6.2 per cent decrease.

source: The Guardian — Easter eggs smaller but pricier
evidence: Maltesers is living up to its “the lighter way to enjoy chocolate” slogan with its XL egg rather less large this year at 194g in many shops, down from 231g in 2025, while the price charged by Tesco has risen by £1 to £7.

source: The Guardian — Easter eggs smaller but pricier
evidence: A similar move with Cadbury’s Twirl eggs – which now include only two individually wrapped Twirl fingers rather than two full bars – means they have shrunk by 9.5% or 23g to 218g.

source: The Guardian — Easter eggs smaller but pricier
evidence: Four fewer eggs in a Mini Eggs family pack means the Cadbury’s treat is now 4% smaller at 256g compared with 270g a year ago

product: Galaxy Milk Chocolate Extra Large Easter Egg
evidence: Which? found a Galaxy Milk Chocolate Extra Large Easter Egg at Asda, which went from £4.98 for 252g in 2025 to £5.97 for 210g in 2026 - a 44 per cent increase in the price per gram.
Which? found the M&M's Crispy Easter Egg went from £3.48 for 192g last year to £3.97 for 156g this year, a 40 per cent increase per gram.

product: Cadbury Mini Eggs Milk Chocolate Easter Egg
evidence: Cadbury Mini Eggs Milk Chocolate Easter Egg went from £4 for 193.5g last year to £5 for 181g this year - a price hike of 34 per cent per gram.

product: Toblerone The Edgy Egg Milk Chocolate Easter Egg
evidence: the Toblerone The Edgy Egg Milk Chocolate Easter Egg With Truffles was reduced from £14 for 298g last year to £15 for 256g this year - an increase of 25 per cent per gram.

product: Cadbury Dairy Milk & White Shell Egg
evidence: The Cadbury Dairy Milk & White Shell Egg at Tesco, for instance, remained at £15, yet the weight dropped from 372g to 360g.
